  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to adopt the

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa requested that staff add our school donation policy to an upcoming council meeting
agenda as a refresher of the policy; and thanked staff who helped plan the carnival event.

Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio thanked staff involved in planning the carnival event.

Mayor De Paula thanked staff for providing programs for our residents.

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 6:34 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, May 14, 2025 at 6:00 PM.
